% hypcap's all option with caption, subcaption, and cleveref: each number,
% \ref, and \cref as in the PDF, and each link landing in its float.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{caption}
\usepackage{subcaption}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage[all]{hypcap}
\usepackage{cleveref}
\begin{document}
\begin{figure}[h]
  \centering
  \begin{subfigure}{0.4\textwidth}
    \centering
    \fbox{Left}
    \caption{Left half}\label{fig:a}
  \end{subfigure}
  \subcaptionbox{Right half\label{fig:b}}{\fbox{Right}}
  \caption{First figure}\label{fig:one}
\end{figure}
\begin{figure}[h]
  \centering
  \captionsetup{name=Fig.}
  \fbox{Second}
  \caption{Second figure}\label{fig:two}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
  \centering
  \caption{First table}\label{tab:one}
  \begin{tabular}{c}1\end{tabular}
\end{table}

Cref: \cref{fig:one}; \cref{fig:a}; \Cref{fig:b}; \cref{fig:two}; \cref{tab:one}.

Range: \cref{fig:one,fig:two}.

Ref: \ref{fig:one}; \ref{fig:a}; \ref{fig:b}; \ref{tab:one}.
\end{document}
